name: Brandfetch
description: Make everything Claude creates look and sound on-brand. Brandfetch pulls a brand's full identity, its logos, colors, fonts, and voice, into your conversation, so Claude can generate decks, emails, and assets grounded in how a company actually looks and talks. Backed by Brandfetch's index of 50M+ brands.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Brandfetch to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Brandfetch to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.brandfetch.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Brandfetch MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brandfetch provides these MCP tools: brand_search, build_logo_urls, enrich_transaction, get_asset_base64, get_brand, and get_brand_context.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Brandfetch?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Brandfetch in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Brandfetch requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Brandfetch is developed by Brandfetch. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
